name: donal
description: Donal Lyonnis, the Bannor hero paladin: tousled brown hair and a short brown beard with a red scar across his face, polished steel pauldrons and steel knee guards, a red tabard with a gold sun emblem and gold trim over brown leather, a brown belt with a gold buckle, a tattered red cape flowing behind him on the screen-left side, tall brown leather boots, and a steel longsword with a gold crossguard in his LEFT hand; no shield
hands: the longsword stays in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty gauntleted fist on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back, the longsword is lifted up over the head with its tip pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the longsword cocked behind the head with its blade hanging down behind the shoulders, the empty right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the arm sweeps over the head and the blade is level, pointing to the lower-right
strike.4: contact: longsword arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the blade slashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the empty right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the blade carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the red cape trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the longsword lifts back toward the ready angle

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the empty right fist flung out to the left, longsword arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the longsword dipping, the empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, longsword arm flung up, the empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the longsword lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the longsword's tip resting on the ground, the empty right fist hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the longsword slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the longsword lies on the ground at the lower-right; the red cape spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the red cape settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the longsword on the ground beside him
